en.dr-ali-peiravi: 25-1 Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Taleqani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Abdul Aziz ibn Yahya al-Jolodi in Basra quoted Ahmad ibn Aban, on the authority of Yahya ibn Salma, on the authority of Zayd ibn al-Harith, on the authority of Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Layli,
“Eighty verses of the Honorable the Exalted God’s Quran were revealed just regarding the characteristics of the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) and no one else in this nation.”
